description: This file defines the Psr17Factory class which implements multiple PSR-17 interfaces to create HTTP message objects such as requests, responses, streams, uploaded files, URIs, and server requests.

classes.name: Psr17Factory
classes.description: A factory class implementing multiple PSR-17 factory interfaces to create HTTP message objects.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP request object with specified method and URI.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP response object with a status code and optional reason phrase.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a new stream object with optional initial content.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream object from a file, opening the file with specified mode.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream object from an existing resource.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates a new uploaded file object with given stream, size, error status, filename, and media type.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a new URI object from a string.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new server request object with method, URI, and server parameters.
